name: Gravelord
description: (Tag:martial+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:physical+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Gravelord, a royal Undead caste evolved for direct combat. You gain mighty physical abilities and virtually unlimited stamina, needing only your own Energy reserves to sustain yourself. You can naturally use [Gravelord's Blade] and gain greatly increased Necrotic, Dark, and Martial affinity, augmenting related skills, magic, and abilities, but you gain vulnerability to Holy- and Light-based abilities and magic.
